purpose: thumbgrid1: y2s91-thumbgrid = (1) one exact GPU pass for odd-size YCbCr thumbnails (375x667: no 376x668 picture, no copy); (2) MobileSlideShow follow-live (re-convert only when seed/probe moved, keep the last good conversion while this process's GPU writes the surface) once the kernel use count is real, else thumbfix5's freeze; render passes into a YCbCr plane move its seed at completion; (3) 'NORD2 PERF PHOTOS CHECK: mismatches=N' (16x16 GPU read-back vs CPU reference, first 16 conversions then 1 in 64); (4) buffer/texture pools with GPU-completion quarantine, converted-thumbnail cache, deferred compute dispatches, UBO tail zeroing; 'NORD2 PERF PHOTOS TG' counters every 5 s. Over thumbfix5 + libmerge6 (backups .pre-thumbgrid1). Switches: guest-thumbgrid1-flags.sh with payload-thumbgrid1-off / -on / -safe or a custom 'flags' file.
build: gpu/build/y2s91-thumbgrid (Nord2Metal: payload/Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal from src/ = thumbfix5 + thumbgrid-redwoodmetal.diff + rw_thumbgrid_pure.h; libredwoodair.dylib: lm6tg-out/ from lm6tg/ = libmerge6 src + thumbgrid-air_metal-on-libmerge6.diff)
kernel_image: any kernel (userland only); follow-live needs the 0398 use count kernel, otherwise the thumbfix5 freeze rule stays
